purpose: prospective replicate-studentized validation-sample certification across all independent-group by information-contrast cells

family_definition.strict_filtration: every estimable independent group x adjacent information step cell
family_definition.complete_lattice: every estimable independent group x directed lattice edge cell
family_definition.critical_value: one two-sided replicate-studentized max-t critical value over the entire family

resampling.between_groups: independent block resampling; this route requires validation-group independence
resampling.within_group: one sampled block sequence is shared across all contrasts in that group
resampling.studentizer: cluster ratio influence standard error recomputed inside every bootstrap replicate

hard_stops.insufficient_blocks: that group x contrast cell is unavailable
hard_stops.filtration_failed_step: certified transfer ceiling cannot skip the step
hard_stops.lattice_failed_edge: failed edge remains failed even when total gain or Shapley average is positive

prohibited_rescues: pooled total gain overriding a failed independent group
later positive filtration step jumping over an earlier failed step
best-path selection after observing lattice outcomes
Shapley contribution overriding a failed lattice edge
